suspension.source_sleeve_angle_basis: Mean of cuff directions from the reconstruction input
suspension.scope: Fixed two-point suspension; absolute comparison in calibrated world coordinates

camera_ray_depth.sign: First mesh hit minus measured range from camera; positive values are farther from the camera
camera_ray_depth.scoring: Both models are scored only on measured rays that hit both meshes. All hit counts are reported.

swing_forecast.method: Short uniform-strip pendulum forecast about the measured support axis

glasgow_stereo_2013.terms: Scientific research only, per the paper
